title: The pullback of a quasi-coherent module is quasi-coherent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the pullback of a quasi-coherent module is quasi-coherent (author lemma at source lines 1302-1308, label lemma-pullback-quasi-coherent). The proof (source lines 1310-1341) reduces, by the argument of the corresponding statement for modules generated by sections, to a module with a global presentation by direct sums of copies of the structure sheaf, and then transports the presentation along the pullback using its compatibility with colimits and its right exactness (proof lines 1311-1339). The reduction and the transport of the presentation are the content. H2.
